questions.prompt: The Rosetta Stone is written in three scripts. Which is not one of them?
questions.fact: Greek was the key: scholars could already read it, which let them work backwards into the two Egyptian scripts.

questions.prompt: Which force causes objects to fall toward the Earth?
questions.fact: It is by far the weakest of the four fundamental forces. A fridge magnet outmuscles the entire planet.

questions.prompt: How many points is a standard basket worth inside the three-point line?
questions.fact: The three-point line only arrived in the NBA in 1979, and was widely dismissed as a gimmick at the time.

questions.prompt: Which streaming series features the Hawkins National Laboratory?
questions.fact: Its title font is a 1980s book-jacket typeface, chosen so the show looked like a paperback before a frame was shot.

questions.prompt: Which sea lies between Turkey and Ukraine?
questions.fact: Below about 150 metres it has almost no oxygen, which has preserved ancient shipwrecks in remarkable condition.

questions.prompt: Which poet is associated with the phrase I wandered lonely as a cloud?
questions.fact: His sister's journal describes the same daffodils two years earlier, in prose many readers find better than the poem.

questions.prompt: Which company created the first commercially successful spreadsheet program?
questions.fact: VisiCalc sold so many Apple IIs that it became the first program credited with selling the computer it ran on.
